name: kurastream
description: Plataforma moderna de streaming de anime y medios en la nube (PHP 8.4 + MySQL).

scripts.start: node scripts/run-php.mjs -d upload_max_filesize=4096M -d post_max_size=4096M -d memory_limit=512M -d max_execution_time=600 -d max_input_time=600 -c php.ini -S 0.0.0.0:3000 php_backend/router.php
scripts.dev: node scripts/run-php.mjs -d upload_max_filesize=4096M -d post_max_size=4096M -d memory_limit=512M -d max_execution_time=600 -d max_input_time=600 -c php.ini -S 0.0.0.0:3000 php_backend/router.php
